claims: Tyson Fury defeated Arslanbek Makhmudov by unanimous decision on Saturday, April 11, 2026, at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium, London.
The main card began at 7 p.m. BST (2 p.m. ET / 11 a.m. PT).
Ring walks for the main event took place around 10 p.m. BST (5 p.m. ET / 2 p.m. PT).
The fight date was Saturday, April 11, 2026.
The fight location was Tottenham Hotspur Stadium, London.
Ring walks were approx. 10:00 p.m. BST / 5:00 p.m. ET / 2:00 p.m. PT.
The broadcast was live on Netflix.
Following his victory, Fury challenged Anthony Joshua to a fight.
